title: Equivalence-arrow spaces descend along fully faithful simplicial cocones
statement:
Let $\mathcal V$ be presentably monoidal and use [def-coef-complete-algebroid] for algebroids, fully faithful maps, essential surjectivity, universes and smallness. For a $\mathcal V$-algebroid $C$ let $U(C)$ be its object space, $I_n(C)=\operatorname{Map}(E^n,C)$ and $I(C)=|I_\bullet(C)|$, as in [lem-coef-algebroid-equivalence-nerve]. The two vertex inclusions $E^0\to E^1$ define $I_1(C)\to U(C)^2$. Let $C_\bullet:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Algd}(\mathcal V)$ be a small coherent simplicial diagram whose every structure map is fully faithful and essentially surjective. Let $(j_n:C_n\to B)$ be a coherent cocone to a $\mathcal V$-algebroid $B$. Suppose every $j_n$ is fully faithful, and the induced comparison $|U(C_\bullet)|\to U(B)$ is an equivalence. Then the natural transformation $I_1(C_\bullet)\to U(C_\bullet)^2$ has pullback naturality squares, and for every $n$ its realization square
$$\begin{matrix}I_1(C_n)&\longrightarrow&|I_1(C_\bullet)|\\ \downarrow&&\downarrow\\ U(C_n)^2&\longrightarrow&|U(C_\bullet)|^2\end{matrix}$$
is a homotopy pullback. Moreover the canonical comparison
$$|I_1(C_\bullet)|\longrightarrow I_1(B)$$
is an equivalence, compatibly with the maps to $U(B)^2\simeq|U(C_\bullet)|^2$. No completeness assumption on $B$ or any $C_n$ is imposed.

source.place: Theorem 5.6.2, final completeness argument from the diagram over object-space squares to the two-out-of-three argument on fibers; generalized from C^{E^bullet} to a fully faithful, essentially surjective simplicial diagram and a fully faithful cocone with colimiting object spaces. Uses Proposition 5.3.6, Lemma 5.3.5 and the cited HTT Theorem 6.1.3.9. Read the retained GH.html source, arXiv:1312.3178v4. Not archived in literature/. No Stacks tag states this operadic infinity-category result.
